cat_rows: This category contains data information air pollution estimates that were modelled for the participants addresses using models developed as part of the European Study of Cohorts for Air Pollution Effects (ESCAPE, http://www.escapeproject.eu/) funded under the EU 7th Framework Programme. Air pollution estimates were modelled for each address using a Land Use Regression (LUR) model.
